name: AI Compliance Framework — Open Knowledge Bundle
description: Machine-readable concept schemas for the AI Compliance Framework reference model, derived from the formal specification and the Java implementation classes.

concepts.description: Lightweight identity base inherited by compliance model objects.
Reference to a human user, service account, or automated agent.
Opaque cross-entity reference key.
DAG of derivation relationships for an artifact.
Domain and use-case classification for an entity.
Normative reference to a regulatory framework article or section.
A normative compliance requirement derived from a regulatory framework.
Descriptor of a data attribute with semantic and observability metadata.
Specification of a population group relevant to a compliance context.
Risk classification of an AI system within a compliance context.
Description of a foreseeable misuse scenario for an AI system.
Profile describing the human oversight configuration for an AI deployment.
Contextualizes an AI project's usage with respect to intended purpose and applicable compliance requirements.
Governance metadata (sensitivity, license, retention, consent) for a dataset.
Data retention policy defining how long and why data is kept.
Specification of data subject consent requirements and conditions.
Schema field descriptor used in tabular data and as model input/output.
Input/output signature of a model's inference function.
Quantitative or qualitative measure of a defined notion.
Composition specification for a composite metric.
Observed value of a single metric within a report.
Confidence interval for a metric result.
Physical unit of measurement for a metric value.
Valid value domain for a metric.
Envelope for compliance objective conditions (threshold, range, categorical, statistical, composite).
Normative constraint binding a Metric to a target value or region.
Content envelope for a compliance report (evaluation, test, or log).
A non-conformance finding produced during a compliance assessment.
Action engaged to resolve a compliance objective violation.
Assessed compliance status of a project or entity at a point in time.
Lightweight documentation artifact scoped to the compliance dimension of an entity.
Structured section within a documentation artifact.
Top-level compliance extension spec attached to any first-class entity.
